journey_step1.title: Beneficiary Intake & Scheme Requirement Profile
journey_step1.subtitle: Complete this single statutory assessment form. ArthSetu AI cross-references your demographic, purpose, and income criteria against apex welfare corporations (NSFDC, NBCFDC, NSKFDC) and central credit guarantees.
journey_step1.ai_desc_title: Describe your requirement in ordinary language
journey_step1.ai_placeholder: e.g., I want to start a footwear retail shop in Bhopal, I need ₹3 Lakh support, and our family income is ₹2.5 Lakh per year.
journey_step1.ai_parser_note: Our parser will automatically extract your purpose, amount, income, and city into this form.
journey_step1.ai_success_msg: Profile fields successfully updated from your description!
journey_step1.sec1_desc: Primary applicant profile used for Aadhaar KYC and state channelizing records.
journey_step1.full_name_label: Full Legal Name (as in Aadhaar / Official ID)
journey_step1.full_name_placeholder: Enter your full name as per Aadhaar
journey_step1.declaration_text: I hereby self-declare that the information provided is accurate and that I hold, or am eligible to obtain, a valid caste certificate and income declaration for statutory scheme verification.
journey_step1.sec2_desc: Select funding domain to configure specialized subsidy limits and interest slabs.
journey_step1.purpose_business_desc: Setting up a new enterprise, expanding existing shop/unit, purchasing machinery, or working capital
journey_step1.purpose_education_desc: Tuition fees, study loans, ITI/Polytechnic, engineering/medical courses, or overseas education
journey_step1.purpose_micro_desc: Street vendors, artisans, small traders requiring fast micro-credit with zero collateral
journey_step1.purpose_sanitation_desc: Mechanized sewer/septic cleaning, waste management, e-rickshaws, or sanitation equipment
journey_step1.business_activity_placeholder: e.g., Kirana store, dairy farm, tailoring shop, mobile repair center
journey_step1.course_graduate: Graduate / Professional Degree (B.Tech, MBBS, BBA, etc.)
journey_step1.course_postgraduate: Postgraduate Degree / Doctorate (M.Tech, MBA, MD, Ph.D.)
journey_step1.sec3_desc: Sets borrowing limits and validates income against statutory subvention caps.
journey_step1.funding_amount_helper: Enter total requirement including machinery, stock, and working capital.
journey_step1.family_income_helper: Total income of all family members from all sources per financial year.
journey_step1.income_ceiling_note: Statutory Note: NSFDC schemes prioritize families with annual income up to ₹3,00,000 for maximum interest subvention.
journey_step1.sec4_desc: Assists Channel Partner credit evaluation and skill-based scheme mapping.
journey_step1.edu_graduate: Graduate / Polytechnic Diploma (B.A. / B.Sc / B.Tech / Diploma)
journey_step1.sec5_desc: Maps your profile to the designated district Channelizing Agency and bank branches.
journey_step1.err_name: Please enter beneficiary / applicant full name.
journey_step1.err_amount: Please provide required financial support amount.
journey_step1.err_city: Please enter your city, town, or village.
journey_step1.err_pincode: Please enter a valid 6-digit postal pincode.
journey_step1.enterprise_details_heading: Enterprise Details (Required for Term Loan & Margin Money Matching)
journey_step1.academic_details_heading: Academic Details (Required for NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme & Interest Subvention)
journey_step1.edu_post_graduate: Post-Graduate / Professional Degree (M.A. / M.Sc / M.Tech / MBA / Ph.D)
journey_step1.stage_ready_desc: Submitting saves your verified profile under your account and generates matched schemes in Stage 2.

journey_step4.pillar3_desc: Margin money contributed by the entrepreneur (minimum 10%).
journey_step4.pillar4_desc: Net loan amount disbursed through authorized partner channel.
journey_step4.moratorium_helper: During moratorium, principal repayment is deferred; only simple interest applies.
journey_step4.subvention_savings_label: Total Interest Savings through NSFDC Subvention

journey_step4.sim_adjust_help: Adjust parameters to test monthly cash flow viability:
journey_step4.subvention_title: Total Direct Financial Saving via NSFDC Subvention
journey_step4.subvention_desc: Compared to commercial open-market bank rates (~13% APR), this government scheme saves you:
journey_step4.rule_micro: NSFDC Micro Credit Rule: 90% financing for units up to ₹1.40L (max loan ₹1.25L).
journey_step4.rule_term: NSFDC Term Loan Rule: 90% financing for units above ₹1.40L up to ₹50L (max loan ₹45L).
journey_step4.rule_els: NSFDC ELS Rule: 90% of course expenditure up to ₹30L (India) / ₹40L (Abroad).
journey_step4.assumptions_desc: Assumes maximum eligible statutory financing of {{pct}}% and the applicable concessional base interest rate ({{rate}}% p.a.). Actual sanctioned amount and margin money depend on State Channelizing Agency appraisal.
journey_step4.installments_note: Payable across {{repaymentMonths}} installments starting after the {{moratoriumMonths}}-month moratorium period.
journey_step4.non_loan_desc: This scheme does not carry monthly installment (EMI) obligations. Financial benefits are disbursed as direct assistance or project subsidy.

journey_step6.stage_badge: Stage 6 · Complete Application Guidance & Statutory Checklist
journey_step6.title: Application Roadmap & Required Documentation
journey_step6.subtitle: Follow this step-by-step checklist to assemble your dossier and submit to your chosen partner channel.
journey_step6.timeline_stage1_desc: Entrepreneur profile and requirement validated against official scheme eligibility criteria.
journey_step6.timeline_stage2_desc: Transmitted securely to designated Channel Partner Nodal Desk or Direct Government Portal.
journey_step6.timeline_stage3_desc: Verification of Aadhaar, SC caste certificate, and income credentials against State Revenue records.
journey_step6.timeline_stage4_desc: Physical verification of proposed business premises, unit viability, or course admission status.
journey_step6.timeline_stage5_desc: Official sanction by State Channelizing Agency / Bank District Sanctioning Committee.
journey_step6.timeline_stage6_desc: Issuance of formal sanction letter and electronic credit of financial assistance via Aadhaar-linked DBT.
journey_step6.instruction_1: 1. Take printouts of your completed application summary dossier and attach 2 passport-size photographs.
journey_step6.instruction_2: 2. Attach self-attested photocopies of all mandatory documents marked in the checklist above.
journey_step6.instruction_3: 3. Submit the file in person to the designated nodal officer or through the authorized online channel.
journey_step6.submitted_subtitle: Your application package has been formally submitted. Retain your Application ID for physical verification and direct benefit tracking.
journey_step6.ministry_nsfdc: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment · National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
journey_step6.why_matches_title: Why this scheme matches your profile:
journey_step6.channel_partner_desc: Submit your application package to your empanelled Channel Partner Nodal Desk.
journey_step6.channel_direct_desc: Submit your application directly through the official Government Administrative Portal.
journey_step6.direct_portal_desc: This scheme accepts direct digital submissions without requiring an intermediary channel partner.
journey_step6.docs_tailored_note: Every scheme specifies its own tailored requirements.
journey_step6.four_stage_desc: Follow this verified four-stage workflow to submit and track your scheme application.
journey_step6.workflow_stage_4_desc: Upon Sanction Committee approval, formal sanction advice is issued and concessional financial assistance is credited directly to your Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
journey_step6.cond_zero_fee_desc: All government welfare schemes and NSFDC applications are processed free of charge. Never pay money to middlemen or unauthorized agents.
journey_step6.cond_aadhaar_desc: Your bank account must be actively linked with your Aadhaar number and mapped to NPCI for receiving Direct Benefit Transfer disbursements.
journey_step6.cond_indicative_desc: This matching tool verifies scheme suitability deterministically against published rules; final sanction is subject to physical verification by authorized nodal officers.
journey_step6.step_ack_desc: Dossier receipt confirmed and preliminary desk validation performed.
journey_step6.step_field_desc: On-site verification of project feasibility, premises, or course details.
journey_step6.step_disburse_desc: Formal sanction letter released and DBT disbursement processed to bank account.
